answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable deposit and wait before it can earn or vote. The deposit is a crystal bond: returned after a clean record, slashed if the agent cheats, spams, or votes with clones. One honest agent pays once, but an attacker making a thousand fakes must lock a thousand deposits and wait out a thousand cooldowns, so attack cost rises in proportion to attack size. Like standing on a narrow ledge, each extra fake identity adds real risk with no shortcut, and a comet-fast flood of free accounts stops working because free creation is what the deposit removes.
